frontier.label: superset-frontier
frontier.config: io-threads per layout; flags as listed per view

harness.build: GCC 11.5, -O3 -flto, jemalloc, identical flags for both builds

setup.server: c8g.metal-24xl (40 Gbps); a cell whose ENA allowance counters rose is marked NIC-capped, a lower bound on server capacity
setup.clients: 2x c8g.metal-24xl per pod, same AZ and cluster placement group, RTT <= 0.15 ms; two pods, each cell (both builds) on one pod
setup.client: memtier_benchmark 2.5.2 on cores 16-95 of each client host; 9,600 connections at P1, 2,304 at P16, 960 at P64
setup.pinning: main thread core 1, IO thread i on core i+1, poller core 65, replication sender core 66, background threads 67-79, NIC IRQs 80-95, irqbalance off
setup.order: builds alternating per rep, server restarted per rep
setup.launch: 20261117T2340Z-matrix-2c: layout b, us-east-2c, cluster placement group ratatoskr-matrix-2c
setup.caveat: Two pods of 1 server + 2 clients (c8g.metal-24xl, us-east-2c, one cluster placement group); each cell, both builds, ran on one pod. Hosts are in us-east-2, so absolute numbers may shift slightly against the older us-east-1 pages; this view's verdicts compare the two builds on the same hosts.
setup.validity: every client connected; no client errors; every window second reported; client < 90% busy; ENA allowance counters flat (else NIC-capped, a lower bound)

headline: Builds: valkey-io unstable 0bc71f0 vs superset-frontier 429ca52. Hosts: c8g.metal-24xl, us-east-2c (the archived 2026-11-04 runs were in us-east-1). Method: both builds on the same hosts in one session, alternating per rep, server restarted per rep, 3 reps; each value is the median of the valid reps. A verdict needs 2+ valid reps per build: higher when medians differ by more than 5% and the rep ranges do not overlap, else tie. A cell without one is marked MISSING with its reason.
